note: Domain coverage dispositions remain distinct from AL-STRUCT-1 input_fate bookkeeping and are never supplied as a second model vocabulary.

derivation_rules.if: input_fate == REJECTED AND no surviving successor change references the input
input_fate == SUPERSEDED AND exactly one SUPERSEDE change targets the input
an UPDATE for the input proposes state_patch.status == DEFERRED and that transition is permitted by the stage status enum/policy
a MERGE change contains the input in source_refs
input_fate == TRANSFORMED AND the input is referenced as source by two or more distinct successor changes and no MERGE rule matched
input remains accounted with one-or-zero successor cardinality and none of REJECT/SUPERSEDE/DEFER/MERGE/SPLIT matched; UPDATE/REVISE may occur without removing the input identity

transformation_stage_constraints: for every accountable input input_fate MUST be present exactly once
CONSUMED and NOT_USED are insufficient for accountable inputs on TRANSFORMATION stages
ambiguous multiple derivations are validation failure
no derived outcome is inferred from annotations or narrative
commit_condition: accountable == derived_disposition_inputs AND foreign==0 AND duplicates==0 AND ambiguous==0
